blocks.html: ROBINSONS MOVIEWORLD PARTNERS WITH CLICK THE CITY

Present during the contract signing were (from L-R): Robinsons Movieworld Marketing Manager Ms. Michelle E. Araullo, Robinsons Malls General Manager Ms. Arlene G. Magtibay, Click the City Managing Director Ms. Dara Pura Virginia D. Vibar and Click the City Sales Director Mr. Edward I. David
Robinsons Movieworld (RMW), one of the largest cinema operators in the country, recently signed an exclusive agreement with Click the City (CTC), an online directory which features restaurants, shops and movie schedules. With this marketing tie-up RMW tickets can now be purchased through the Click the City app which can be downloaded for free in iOS and Android devices. Also, movie goers can book their movie seats in any of the 25 Robinsons Movieworld branches nationwide.

Present during the contract signing were (from L-R): Robinsons Movieworld Marketing Manager Ms. Michelle E. Araullo, Robinsons Malls General Manager Ms. Arlene G. Magtibay, Click the City Managing Director Ms. Dara Pura Virginia D. Vibar and Click the City Sales Director Mr. Edward I. David.
